newsitem.title: USA: Turner unit to air live Nasdaq quotes.
newsitem.headline: Turner unit to air live Nasdaq quotes.

text.p: The cable television network CNNfn, a unit of Turner Broadcasting System Inc, will begin broadcasting live market information from Nasdaq on Monday, January 27, Nasdaq said.
The electronic exchange said in a statement released Friday that CNNfn would be the first television network to air live quotes from the three major U.S. stock markets.
CNNfn will air quotes at the start of the trading day during its "In the Game" program, which runs from 0900 to 1700 EST Monday through Friday.
CNNfn, a production of Turner's Cable News Network's Financial News, started broadcasting from the American Stock Exchange on Friday and the New York Stock Exchange on December 12.
